evals.prompt: I'm modeling a Product in my Flutter Clean Architecture app. Should the domain entity have fromJson/toJson? Where does JSON serialization belong?
evals.expected_output: Domain entities NEVER have fromJson/toJson. JSON serialization belongs exclusively in the data layer (DTOs). ProductDto has @freezed + fromJson/toJson. ProductMapper converts between them. Product entity has no json annotation.

assertions.text: Response explicitly states domain entities NEVER have fromJson/toJson — JSON is a data layer concern
Response places JSON serialization in a DTO class in the data layer, not in the entity
Response mentions a Mapper (or equivalent) to convert between DTO and domain entity

evals.prompt: I'm migrating from dartz to fpdart in my Flutter project. What changes do I need to make to my Either handling code?
evals.expected_output: Main change: .fold((l) => ..., (r) => ...) becomes .match((l) => ..., (r) => ...) in fpdart. Right/Left unchanged. Option/Some/None mostly unchanged. TaskEither available for async composition. Shows migration table.

assertions.text: Response identifies that .fold() becomes .match() in fpdart — this is the primary breaking change
Response correctly states that Right(value) and Left(failure) usage is unchanged
Response mentions TaskEither as a new addition in fpdart for async composition

evals.prompt: Show me how to create BLoC states for a product detail screen using Freezed. The screen can be loading, showing a product, or in an error state.
evals.expected_output: Uses @freezed sealed class ProductState with factory constructors for initial/loading/success/error. Uses Dart 3 switch expression for exhaustive matching in build(). State class is sealed (not plain class) for Freezed 3.x compatibility and exhaustive switch.

assertions.text: Response uses @freezed sealed class (not just @freezed class) for the union state type
Response shows Dart 3 switch expression for exhaustive pattern matching in the widget/build method
Response includes all required states: at minimum loading, success (with product data), and error

evals.prompt: I want to model an Email value object and a Moneand value object in my Flutter domain layer using Dart 3.3+. How do I do this without Freezed?
evals.expected_output: Uses Dart 3.3+ extension types: extension type Email(String value) implements String with factory Email.parse() that validates, trandParse(), and _isValid(). extension type Moneand(double value) with arithmetic operators. Both are zero-cost wrappers — no runtime overhead.

assertions.text: Response uses Dart 3.3+ extension types (extension type Email(String value)) — not a class wrapper
Response includes a factory Email.parse() constructor that validates the value and throws on invalid input
Response shows Email.trandParse() as a null-returning alternative for safe parsing
